Branch protection on main now requires the U1 contracts check, and a red required check did leave pull request 4 unmergeable through two failing runs. This stays a GAP on the rest of the criterion: merge readiness was never formally evaluated and recorded against a failed required check, and the branch safeguards are not verified under SS-01. The vulnerability gate is deliberately not a required context while its 12 advisories are undispositioned, so it does not demonstrate blocking either.

The workflow keeps every job read-only with no secrets and the policy refuses a self-hosted runner on an untrusted trigger, which assertCiPolicy verifies. The criterion also requires that OQ8 resolve runner isolation, and OQ8 is open and scheduled for Bolt 2 under U2/U13: trusted-runner and state/backend controls are to be defined before CI deployment. A synthetic workflow-changing pull request has also not been exercised against the protected base.

The vulnerability gate fails and scan:vuln exits 1 with 12 advisories after the owner-approved AsyncAPI CLI upgrade from 6.0.2 to 6.2.0, down from 55. The gate correctly blocks: the residue is undispositioned. Every remaining advisory arrives through the generate and convert subcommands of the CLI, while this project invokes only validate, inside a container with no network, a read-only filesystem, no secrets and a dropped capability set - an exposure argument, not a disposition. The drafted U2 check runs this gate as its own job so the finding is visible as itself.
